name: tournament-hub
description: Self-contained tournament management: HTTP API, migrations, realtime fan-out and web application

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,realtime,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:dependencies: docker compose up --detach --wait postgres redis migrations
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace=@tournament-hub/api -- --runInBand && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@tournament-hub/migrations
scripts.verify: npm run check:architecture && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:contract && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:local: npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && node scripts/verify-local.mjs
scripts.reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run up
